# 🤖 ONE-CLICK Bot Installation Guide (100% FREE)

All configuration files are ready! Just click these links to install (takes 30 seconds each):

## ✅ Ready to Install (Just 1 Click Each):

### 1. **Codecov** - Test Coverage Reports
**Link:** https://github.com/apps/codecov
- Click "Install it for free"
- Select "Locvel" organization
- Choose "Only select repositories" → Check "voite"
- Click "Install"
- ✅ Configuration file already added: `codecov.yml`

---

### 2. **All Contributors Bot** - Recognize Contributors
**Link:** https://github.com/apps/allcontributors
- Click "Install it for free"
- Select "Locvel" organization
- Choose "Only select repositories" → Check "voite"
- Click "Install"
- ✅ Configuration file already added: `.all-contributorsrc`

---

### 3. **ImgBot** - Automatic Image Optimization
**Link:** https://github.com/apps/imgbot
- Click "Install it for free"
- Select "Locvel" organization
- Choose "Only select repositories" → Check "voite"
- Click "Install"
- ✅ Configuration file already added: `.imgbotconfig`

---

### 4. **Renovate** - Advanced Dependency Management
**Link:** https://github.com/apps/renovate
- Click "Install it for free"
- Select "Locvel" organization
- Choose "Only select repositories" → Check "voite"
- Click "Install"
- ✅ Configuration file already added: `renovate.json`

---

## 🎯 After Installation:

All bots will automatically:
- ✅ Read their config files from the repo
- ✅ Start working immediately
- ✅ Create PRs when needed
- ✅ Stay 100% FREE forever (for public repos)

**Total time:** ~2 minutes to install all 4 bots
